Imagine thinking black people are so stupid that they didn’t know they were oppressed until #BLM convinced them of it. 

That’s the argument I just heard from a fundamentalist friend. https://t.co/a57tl74Lb2

If you can't say #BlackLivesMatter or are silent about the #POTUS's "shit home countries" rhetoric you sure as Hades better not go on a mission trip to "help" non-white people. You're not helping, you're not preaching the gospel, your being a white savior.

I'm pretty sure in psychology it's called "projection" when a white dude says something like, "#BLM hates people because  of the color of their skin."

I could be wrong. I'm not psychologist. But there's definitely some weirdness happening in a statement like that.
